name: DepositX
description: Proof-of-concept model of par, atomic settlement between banks' deposit tokens. Consensus is simulated in one process; no bank partner; not regulated; not live.

roles.name: settlement-model
roles.purpose: Models par, atomic cross-bank settlement on a simulated network so its invariants can be tested and replayed.
roles.measure: Simulated blocks that replay to the same state root, as a share of blocks produced

roles.name: risk-control
roles.purpose: Halts the simulated network when any invariant breaks and refuses the instruction that broke it.
roles.measure: Invariant checks that pass, as a share of checks run
